title: 第25章 齐聚南域
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
她的朱雀呢？

    微生璃月将怀里那只试图舔舐她脸庞的红色小狗抱起，仔仔细细观察了几遍，愣是看不出一点跟朱雀有关联的地方。

    刚出生的小家伙见主人抱着自己翻来覆去地查看，还以为微生璃月这是在关心它，一个劲哼唧着。

    “小家伙，你是什么神兽？”

    原谅微生璃月见识浅薄，她还从没见过长得跟狗一样的神兽。

    虽然红毛小狗看起来挺可爱的，但感觉跟她印象中的神兽形象有点不符。

    “主人，伦家是业火麒麟啦！”

    许是刚出生不久，小家伙说话有点黏糊，只想着往微生璃月身边凑，自然是她问什么就说什么。

    “业火麒麟？”

    听上去很厉害的样子，就是这萌萌哒的形象……

    算了，好歹是神兽。

    而且从刚才的异象来看，这小家伙应该不弱。

    “既然是麒麟，那你以后就叫微生麒，可以吗？”

    跟小玄羽一样，都跟着她姓。

    “可以的主人，小麒很喜欢这个名字！”

    红色小狗见主人右肩膀上还站着个彩毛鸡，当即缩成巴掌大小的样子，占据左肩的位置，顺带蹭蹭微生璃月侧颈。

    嘿嘿嘿，它比空间里另外几个要先出生，能多点时间跟主人交流感情，以后在主人心中的地位肯定也比其他神兽重要。

    此时的青云洲域，各方闭关老祖纷纷出动，齐聚南域，其中不乏大乘期修士。

    来人中修为最高者，当属天剑宗老祖裴峰，渡劫初期修士。

    天生异象，必有至宝降世。

    但凡有点实力，没人会放弃这来之不易的机缘，尤其是这些不知道活了多少年的老怪物。

    在他们心里，只要能拿到这件至宝，必定能助力自己修为更进一步，再不济也不能让其他宗门占了先机。
content_en:
Where is her Suzaku?

Weisheng Liyue picked up the red puppy in her arms that was trying to lick her face and observed it carefully several times, but couldn't see anything related to Suzaku.

The newborn baby saw its owner holding him and turning over and over, thinking that Weisheng Liyue was caring about him, so he kept humming.

"Little guy, what kind of beast are you?"

Forgive Weisheng Liyue for her limited knowledge, but she has never seen a mythical beast that looks like a dog.

Although the red-haired puppy looks cute, it feels a bit inconsistent with the image of the mythical beast in her impression.

"Master, the Lun family is a karmic fire unicorn!"

Xu was just born, so the little guy was a bit sticky when talking. He just wanted to get close to Weisheng Liyue, so naturally he said whatever she asked.

"Yehuo Qilin?"

It sounds very powerful, but it is this cute image...

Forget it, it’s a mythical beast after all.

And judging from the vision just now, this little guy shouldn't be weak.

"Since you are Qilin, then you will be called Wei Shengqi from now on, is that okay?"

Like Xiao Xuanyu, they all follow her surname.

"It's okay, Master, Xiao Qi likes this name very much!"

When the red puppy saw a colorful chicken standing on its owner's right shoulder, it immediately shrunk down to the size of a palm, took up the position on the left shoulder, and rubbed the side of Weisheng Liyue's neck.

Hehehe, it was born earlier than the others in the space. It can spend more time communicating with its owner, and its status in the owner's heart will definitely be more important than other mythical beasts in the future.

At this time, in the Qingyun Continent, the retreating ancestors from all sides were dispatched one after another to gather in the southern region, including many Mahayana monks.

The one with the highest cultivation level among the visitors is undoubtedly Pei Feng, the ancestor of Tianjian Sect, a monk in the early stage of crossing the tribulation.

Born with a vision, a treasure must come to the world.

As long as they have some strength, no one will give up this hard-won opportunity, especially these old monsters who have lived for who knows how many years.

In their hearts, as long as they can get this treasure, it will definitely help them improve their cultivation. No matter how bad it is, other sects will not be able to take advantage of it.
title_en: Chapter 25 Gathering in the Southern Region
